design_vision: Dense data terminal, operational photographic memory, cognitive infrastructure console for venture analysts.

spacing_and_layout.gap: gap-px or gap-4 depending on density needs
spacing_and_layout.padding_philosophy: Dense and tight for data tables (p-2 to p-4), generous padding for main panels (p-6).
spacing_and_layout.border_style: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton, 1px solid borders border-[#222222].

components.cards: Flat background (#0A0A0A), 1px solid border (#222222), no shadow. Hover: border color brightens.
components.buttons: Sharp edges, flat colors. Primary uses #FF4F00 background with white text. Secondary uses transparent background with 1px border and hover effect.
components.navigation: Side or top navigation with a solid #050505 background and hard bottom/right border. Active states marked with a thin 2px left-border of #FF4F00.
components.tables: Dense, monospace accents for numbers, sticky headers, subtle 1px border bottom for rows.
components.charts: Recharts with monospace labels. Lines/bars use primary accent (#FF4F00) and status colors.

images.description: Minimalist abstract geometric line-art logo of a ferret
Dark observability dashboard background texture, knowledge graph
Vibrant orange lines and dots form an abstract network on a dark background

testing.guideline: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based format.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the specified colors and fonts.
2. Ensure pages are strictly .js and not .tsx.
3. Use JetBrains Mono for all data points, code blocks, metrics, and labels.
4. Use sharp borders (rounded-none) and border-collapse techniques to create the 'Technical' grid look.
5. Avoid any soft shadows or glowing gradients, rely strictly on contrast and 1px borders for hierarchy.
6. Make heavy use of the primary_accent (#FF4F00) for active signals and data nodes.
7. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid.
